title: Extended register valuation
statement: Given a valuation $\rho$ of $R$ natural-number registers and natural numbers $p$, $oc$, and $tm$, define a valuation of $R+3$ registers by assigning the first $R$ coordinates their values under $\rho$, coordinate $R$ the value $p$, coordinate $R+1$ the value $oc$, and every remaining coordinate the value $tm$.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ assigns a natural number to each of the first $R$ registers
